name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a commercial agreement covering a provider's AI services, including customer input, generated output, and training restrictions.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate agreement governing a provider's handling of protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a customer.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for a customer's subscription to a provider's cloud service, including access, fees, term, and liability.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement giving a design partner early access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Terms governing the processing of personal data by a provider on behalf of a customer, including subprocessors and security.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA under which each party may disclose confidential information to the other for a stated purpose.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA, where the parties fill in the purpose, effective date, term, and governing law.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement between two companies setting out the obligations, referrals, and cooperation terms of a business partnership.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement allowing a prospective customer to evaluate a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Terms for a provider performing professional services for a customer under one or more statements of work (SOWs).

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Terms for uptime targets, support response times, and service credits for a cloud service.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing software to a customer, including license grant, fees, support, and liability.
